QuestInfo.name: [Erel Light] Encroaching Shadows
QuestInfo.0: Let #p9201719# know about the increased security.
QuestInfo.1: You spent the first wonderful night in a long time with your siblings. But right as you were about to fall asleep with a full belly, you noticed a shower of dark stars! Could it be possible that what #p9201713# and #p9201717# said is coming to pass?
QuestInfo.2: #p9201722# said that a star glanced off the barrier, causing a shadow to scatter around the nearby area.
